title: Personal Credit Cards: does the autopay instruction cover the minimum due? (autopay bank error test)
content:
# Personal Credit Cards: autopay instruction covering the minimum due

This rule belongs to the Personal Credit Cards line. When the ground for reversing a late payment fee on a card that carried an automatic payment instruction is decided, the bank error ground requires that the autopay instruction on the card would have debited at least the minimum due.

## Rule

1. The instruction examined is the kind of automatic payment instruction recorded on the card, with its fixed amount where the instruction is a fixed amount instruction.
2. A minimum due or a statement balance instruction would have debited at least the minimum due.
3. A fixed amount instruction qualifies only when its fixed amount is at least the minimum payment due on the card's most recent statement.
4. An instruction of none never qualifies.

## Decision table

| Autopay instruction on the card | Covers the minimum due |
|---|---|
| minimum due | yes |
| statement balance | yes |
| fixed amount, fixed amount at least the statement's minimum payment due | yes |
| fixed amount, fixed amount below the statement's minimum payment due | no |
| none | no |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical figures, minimum payment due 35.00 USD)

- Fixed amount of 35.00 USD: equal to the minimum due, so it is at least the minimum and the instruction qualifies.
- Fixed amount of 34.99 USD: below the minimum due, so the instruction does not qualify.
- Fixed amount of 250.00 USD: above the minimum due, so the instruction qualifies.
- No automatic payment instruction (an instruction of none): does not qualify, whatever amount appears elsewhere.

## Basis Q&A

**Q: Does a statement balance instruction need any amount comparison?**
A: No. A minimum due or statement balance instruction qualifies on its own; the amount comparison applies only to a fixed amount instruction.

**Q: Which minimum is the fixed amount compared with?**
A: The minimum payment due on the card's most recent statement.
